name: Agulo (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Agulo (a lion on blue).
history: The flag of Agulo was approved by order of 27 May 2002 as a rectangular cloth whose length is one and a half times its width, blue, with a yellow diagonal stripe from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly corner, of a fifth of the width of the cloth; if the flag bears the heraldic arms of the municipality, they are placed at the centre.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, a fifth of the width
